_comment: Template for webkit.config.json. Fill project_name, site_root, default_page, lock_dir, palette ports, browser, and feedback_dir for the project. site_root is the served document root; feedback_dir stays relative to the Git root. The server binds to 127.0.0.1 unless bind_host is explicitly added. hotkeys values are layout-independent KeyboardEvent.code names. Toggle and dictate shortcuts are disabled whenever an input, textarea, or contenteditable field is focused, so their literal characters remain typable in feedback notes. Speech recognition language is selected in the overlay and persisted locally.
